title: Refund Desk Decision Table: Attendance History and the No-Show Fee Offset (In-Person Appointments)
content:
**Decision table for the no-show fee the refund offsets on a missed In-Person Appointments visit.** The visit type's no-show fee is raised, for the no-show fee the refund offsets, according to the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account, counting no-show fee and late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the refund date.

| Condition on the ledger | Result for the visit type's no-show fee |
|---|---|
| 2 or more such charges, at least one of them a no-show fee | Raised by half (multiplied by 1.5) |
| At least 1 such charge, but not that combination | Raised by a quarter (multiplied by 1.25) |
| None | Taken as it stands (multiplied by 1) |

Charges of any other kind, such as virtual-visit fees, are not counted for the no-show fee the refund offsets.

**Test rows (hypothetical ledgers, refund dated 2026-11-25).**

1. Two late-cancellation fee charges, dates of service 2026-02-10 and 2026-06-03: 2 charges, no no-show fee among them, so 1.25.
2. One no-show fee charge dated 2026-04-18 and one late-cancellation fee charge dated 2026-09-09: 1.5.
3. One no-show fee charge with a date of service of 2025-11-01: more than 12 whole months before the refund date, not counted, so 1.
4. A single virtual-visit fee charge: another kind, not counted, so 1.

For an In-Office Procedure Visit, no-show fee $125.00: 1.25 gives $156.25 and 1.5 gives $187.50.
